final: WITH staff_totals AS (SELECT r.staff_id, SUM(p.amount) AS staff_total FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id GROUP BY r.staff_id), overall_total AS (SELECT SUM(staff_total) AS total FROM staff_totals) SELECT st.staff_id, st.staff_total, st.staff_total / ot.total AS ratio FROM staff_totals st CROSS JOIN overall_total ot WHERE st.staff_total IS NOT NULL AND ot.total IS NOT NULL
